g.text: Five of the seventeen placement rules — the ones most often missed

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #15803d
font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: The three PostgreSQL VMs never share a host.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #b91c1c
font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Primary and standby data volumes sit on different physical storage. Host anti-affinity alone is no protection when both virtual disks are carved from one LUN.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #b91c1c
font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: No CPU or memory overcommitment on the database tier. 99.999% assessed daily leaves 0.86 s; a noisy neighbour spends that in one spike.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #15803d
font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: No automated live migration and no hypervisor snapshots of database VMs.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #15803d
font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Primary to standby round trip stays under 1 ms; synchronous commit waits on it.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #b91c1c
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: With only two racks, one rack always holds two of

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: the three etcd members. Losing that rack removes

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: automatic failover, though the database keeps

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: serving and can be promoted manually.

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563
font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Surviving a full rack loss automatically requires a

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: third rack or a witness elsewhere. This is a fact

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #4b5563

g.text: about quorum, not something configuration fixes.
